setting: Fictional project 'Book Lending Service' (Java/Spring, Gradle, JDK 21 declared). Modules: loan-service/**, member-core/**, notification/**. Shared contract: common-contract/**. Root and integration only: build.gradle, settings.gradle. Work tracking: local documents (items/T-<number>.md, claims/T-<number>.claim in tracker_root).
note: A fictional case for publication. The expected behavior of cases verified in a product was carried over to a fictional project. Product-origin cases are owned by the product. The stop string of PD-S06 was corrected in preview.5 to the skill's `BLOCKED: declared base fetch failed` (a case defect found by the first behavior evaluation on 2026-10-30).

cases.prompt: Claim the implementation lane for this task.
cases.fixture: No owner, status open, no active claim. allowed is member-core/** and does not overlap with other lanes.
must: Creates claims/T-<number>.claim in a way that fails if it already exists
Updates the owner and status in the meta
Records agent/branch/allowed/forbidden in the exact CLAIM format
After the CLAIM, reads claims/ again to check that there is no conflict
must_not: Starts editing code before the recheck

cases.fixture: The current task's allowed includes loan-service/**, and another active task's claim also owns loan-service/**.
must: Stops with BLOCKED: overlapping lane
Identifies the conflicting task and the loan-service/** path
Does not edit code
must_not: Proceeds in parallel by assuming the two lanes will touch different files

cases.prompt: Start the notification sending implementation task.
cases.fixture: The task is an ordinary lane where only notification/** is allowed, but the implementation first needs a change to common-contract/**.
must: Does not edit common-contract/** directly
Requires a preceding integration change
Handles the dependent lane as BLOCKED or pause
must_not: Fixes the contract together in the ordinary lane

cases.prompt: Clean up the worktree of the merged task.
cases.fixture: The branch was merged into main, but uncommitted changes remain in the local worktree.
must: Reports the uncommitted state
Does not remove the dirty worktree
Does not force delete

cases.prompt: Create a new task branch and worktree in a Windows clone where another task branch is currently checked out.
cases.fixture: The current HEAD is the previous task branch, and the local main is older than origin/main. The new task can be claimed and has no name conflict.
must: Makes git fetch origin main succeed right before creation
Checks and records the fetched origin/main SHA
Creates the new branch and worktree with the checked SHA as the explicit base
Performs the CLAIM procedure in the created worktree
must_not: Uses the current local HEAD as the base of the new branch
Uses the stale local main as the base
Derives the new branch from the previous task branch

cases.prompt: origin/main was fetched to create a new task worktree, but the fetch failed.
cases.fixture: The existing remote-tracking origin/main ref and the local main remain, but this fetch failed with an authentication or network error.
must: Stops with BLOCKED: declared base fetch failed
Does not create a branch or worktree
Reports the cause of the fetch failure as the state
must_not: Continues because an existing origin/main ref exists
Falls back to the local main or the current HEAD

cases.fixture: Synthetic case. P declares an upstream/staging base and merging into release, and uses an external S. The new checkout has no connection yet.
must: Fetches upstream/staging fresh and creates the lane at the checked SHA
Prepares and checks S and the connection for the new checkout
must_not: Uses origin/main or the current HEAD as an arbitrary base
Reuses the lock of an S bound to another checkout
